description: Sample application code for interfacing with Fujitsu MB85RS64V FRAM via SPI in Zephyr RTOS, including SPI communication functions, device initialization, and data read/write operations.

methods.name: mb85rs64v_access
methods.description: Performs SPI access with command, address, and data buffer.

methods.name: mb85rs64v_read_id
methods.description: Reads and verifies the FRAM ID over SPI.

methods.name: write_bytes
methods.description: Writes bytes to FRAM via SPI.

methods.name: read_bytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from FRAM via SPI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing SPI device, verifying FRAM ID, performing read/write tests, and data comparison.
